title: Golden master of Stage -1 (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/golden.json, not committed)
description: Refactor and legacy only. Before any role runs, the black-box engine records its I/O over the cases of tests.golden_master on the base, and this file keeps the hashes. Stage 4 replays the same cases on the candidate and compares them with these hashes: the oracle that the legacy behavior is preserved. A golden master with no cases is not one; if it cannot be recorded, Stage -1 escalates prerequisite_failure.

command.description: tests.golden_master.command as it was in config.json.
